letter.subject: Civil Site Engineer, Perth (SEEK)
paragraphs: Please accept my application for the Civil Site Engineer role advertised on SEEK. Reading drawings, completing daily ITPs and QA records, procuring materials and writing weekly progress reports is the site work I want to build my career on, and it follows on from work I have already done.

From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines. As project-in-charge on a community hall renovation I coordinated 10 to 15 workers each day, reviewed structural and architectural drawings and carried out site inspections, safety checks and quality monitoring. As a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works I tracked procurement and materials, prepared site reports, material records and progress reports, and worked with engineers, subcontractors and suppliers to sort out site issues.

I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (Philippines, 2019), and in February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute in Australia, where I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement systems and stormwater drainage in AutoCAD and Civil 3D. I also lodged Before You Dig enquiries and designed around existing services.

I hold a White Card and an Australian driver's licence, have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa, and am available for FIFO and site based work. My site experience is about ten months and overseas, so variations, EOTs and Microsoft Project scheduling are areas I would be learning from your team.
I have attached my resume and would welcome the chance to talk about the role.
